groupings.title: Flight Search
groupings.description: Find when to fly and where to go: scan a whole departure-date range, or fan a list of destination airports out in one real-time Google Flights search, ranked cheapest first and judged against Google's own price_insights_low / price_insights_high band. Not affiliated with Google.

groupings.title: Fare and Rate Monitoring
groupings.description: Re-check one pinned route over time for a book-now-or-wait verdict, or price the same hotel and dates as a resident of several countries would see them via proxy_country to expose rate-parity gaps. Every check is a fresh live call: fares go stale in minutes and are never reused.

groupings.title: Hotels and Stays
groupings.description: Search real-time Booking.com properties by free-text destination and dates with budget_per_night and 24 filters, or check one named hotel's availability and nightly price. Sold out comes back as available: false, which is an answer, not an error. Not affiliated with Booking.com.

groupings.title: Trip Planning and Client Output
groupings.description: Total round-trip airfare and lodging across aligned checkin_date / checkout_date into one all-in per-person trip budget, then write the options up as a client-ready brief with booking links and a prices-checked-at timestamp.

groupings.title: Developer Workflows
groupings.description: Routing and reference for the underlying REST APIs and the hosted flights MCP servers: auth headers, both hosts, endpoints, request parameters, exact response field names, empty-array and non-200 handling, MCP tool mapping, and per-request billing.
